questions.question: Why does the adapter maintain openedTextIds as a Set<string>?
options: To buffer text for the consume() method
To prevent duplicate reply.item.added events for the same text item
questions.explanation: openedTextIds is a Set that deduplicates text item additions, ensuring reply.item.added fires exactly once per item.

questions.question: A provider sends { type: "tool-result", toolCallId: "tc1", toolName: "bash", result: { stdout: "hello" } }. Which events does the adapter emit?
questions.explanation: tool-result always produces tool_call.completed followed by reply.item.done to close the item lifecycle.

questions.question: The consume() method wraps stream iteration in a try/catch. What event does it emit if the AsyncIterable throws?
options: It re-throws the error so the caller handles it
It emits reply.completed with an error flag
It emits reply.failed with the error message
questions.explanation: consume() swallows exceptions and emits reply.failed so downstream consumers can handle errors gracefully.
